name: Happy Path — Book Employee Only Appointment
goal: Book an annual health checkup appointment for the employee only, with all valid inputs.
constraints: All user inputs are valid and provided on first attempt. Journey follows Employee Only coverage.

result.message: You are eligible to book your annual health checkup.

phases.description: Eligibility check and booking intent confirmation.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot presents booking option and user selects 'Book an appointment'.
User selects 'Employee Only' and bot proceeds to appointment date.
User provides valid appointment date, bot validates date successfully.

phases.description: Mobile number, state, city, and clinic selection.
phases.completionCriteria: User provides valid mobile, state, city, and selects clinic via rich media.
Bot confirms appointment booking and displays selected clinic name.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
